definition:
struct RationalBezierAlgebraicTangentImageData {
    status: BezierAlgebraicImageStatus,
    parameter: AlgebraicRootRepresentation,
    dx: Option<BezierAlgebraicRationalCoordinateImage>,
    dy: Option<BezierAlgebraicRationalCoordinateImage>,
    retained_expression: Option<RetainedRationalTangentExpression>,
    message: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
struct RetainedRationalTangentExpression {
    parameter: BezierAlgebraicParameter2,
    dx_numerator: Vec<Real>,
    dy_numerator: Vec<Real>,
    denominator: Vec<Real>,
}
observations: The shared derivative carrier still stores status and independently optional dx/dy/expression/message fields.
rational_tangent_image drops the uncertainty reason returned by RationalCoordinateImagePair::Failed and retains only its status.
Lazy endpoint tangent caches keep CurveResult reports, including failures; point caches retain only successes.
next: Audit classified derivative construction and one explicit successful definition, preserving diagnostic consumers and derivative demand; no new candidate or reproduced cache failure.
